name: Agent proposal 回执读取、迁移与隔离
subject: agent-proposal.receipt-read-recovery

forbidden_derivations.why: 回执的旧格式迁移只许在 store 里定义一份；调用方自己解析 / 迁移回执、或自己决定读不出的文件挡不挡项目打开，就会再出现 0.22.5→0.23 那种一份文件让项目打不开的情况。

notes: The main-process store is the shared read boundary. Recognized pre-journal data is migrated idempotently; malformed, truncated, hash-invalid, or binding-mismatched data is renamed beside the original with a reason code and read as no pending receipt so project open can continue.
